_meta.content: Stufe-60-PvE-Builds (Dungeon/Raid), Konsens aus mehreren Guides; Lernreihenfolge abgeleitet.

WARRIOR.name: Waffen (Dungeon)
WARRIOR.note: All three sources take the identical 32-point Arms tree and Cruelty 5 / Enrage 5 / Improved Execute 2. Majority for the rest: Unbridled Wrath 5 (Method, Mobalytics; Wowhead uses Lingering Rage 5), Reckless Swings 1 (Method, Mobalytics), Improved Bloodrage 1 (Mobalytics; Wowhead 2, Method uses Lingering Rage 1 instead). Result equals the Mobalytics build. No source separates dungeon and raid.

WARRIOR.name: Waffen (Schlachtzug)
WARRIOR.note: All three sources take the identical 32-point Arms tree and Cruelty 5 / Enrage 5 / Improved Execute 2. Majority for the rest: Unbridled Wrath 5 (Method, Mobalytics; Wowhead uses Lingering Rage 5), Reckless Swings 1 (Method, Mobalytics), Improved Bloodrage 1 (Mobalytics; Wowhead 2, Method uses Lingering Rage 1 instead). Result equals the Mobalytics build. No source separates dungeon and raid.

WARRIOR.name: Furor (Schlachtzug)
WARRIOR.note: Unanimous: Wowhead, Method and Mobalytics give the identical 17/34/0 build.

WARRIOR.name: Furor (Dungeon)
WARRIOR.note: Method and Mobalytics have one build for all content (= raid build). Wowhead has a separate dungeon build that differs by 3 points (Enrage 5, Lingering Rage 1, no Improved Berserker Rage).

WARRIOR.name: Schutz (Schlachtzug)
WARRIOR.note: Per-talent majority: 27-point Protection core shared by all; Anticipation 5 for raid (Wowhead + Method); Fury Cruelty 5 / Unbridled Wrath 5 / Enrage 5 (Wowhead + both Mobalytics guides). Equals the Wowhead standard build. Main disagreement: Method puts the off-tree points into Arms (Deep Wounds/Impale), Mobalytics prefers Improved Thunder Clap over Anticipation.

WARRIOR.name: Schutz (Dungeon)
WARRIOR.note: All dungeon builds take Improved Thunder Clap 3 + the 27-point core and Cruelty/Unbridled Wrath/Enrage. Reckless Swings 1 in 2 of 3 (Method, Mobalytics). The last 2 Protection points differ in every source (Improved Bloodrage / Anticipation / Improved Shield Bash); took the Mobalytics build, which also matches Warcraft Tavern's 3/16/32 split.

PALADIN.name: Heilig (Schlachtzug)
PALADIN.note: Shared core of 29 Holy points plus Divine Intellect 5 and Benediction/Conviction/Sanctified Judgement/Pursuit of Justice in all three. Per-talent majority adds Holy Conduit 2 (Method, Mobalytics) and Divine Precision 2 (Wowhead, Mobalytics) = the Mobalytics build (most recent).

PALADIN.name: Heilig (Dungeon)
PALADIN.note: Only Wowhead has a separate dungeon build. Same allocation as raid (majority of Mobalytics/Method); Wowhead dungeon variant noted.

PALADIN.name: Schutz (Schlachtzug)
PALADIN.note: Wowhead and Method give the identical 0/35/16 build. Mobalytics goes 4 points deeper in Protection.

PALADIN.name: Schutz (Dungeon)
PALADIN.note: No two sources agree on a dungeon-specific build; used the standard build that Wowhead (raid) and Method agree on. Wowhead's dungeon variant swaps Anticipation for Guardian's Favor + Vindication.

PALADIN.name: Vergeltung (Schlachtzug)
PALADIN.note: Unanimous 12/8/31 (Unsealed Wrath / seal-twisting). All three also list a 23/0/28 Holy Shock "Shockadin" alternative.

PALADIN.name: Vergeltung (Dungeon)
PALADIN.note: Unanimous 12/8/31 (Unsealed Wrath / seal-twisting). All three also list a 23/0/28 Holy Shock "Shockadin" alternative.

DRUID.name: Gleichgewicht (Schlachtzug)
DRUID.note: Post-hotfix (Nov 25) sources only. Wowhead and Method agree exactly on the 44-point core; the 7 flex points follow Wowhead's raid variant. Mobalytics Balance guide still uses the pre-hotfix tree (Improved Wrath, Moonfury, Improved Starfire 5) and was discarded.

DRUID.name: Gleichgewicht (Dungeon)
DRUID.note: Same 44-point core as raid; flex points into crowd control (useful on trash). Allocation identical in Wowhead and Method (leveling guide).

DRUID.name: Gleichgewicht (Leveln)
DRUID.note: Only post-hotfix sources (Nov 26). All talents exist in the reworked tree. Maxroll (Nov 3/4) and Mobalytics Balance leveling are pre-hotfix (Moonfury, Improved Starfire 5) and were discarded.

DRUID.name: Wilder Kampf – Katze (Schlachtzug)
DRUID.note: Unanimous: identical cat build 9/32/10 in Wowhead, Method and Mobalytics.

DRUID.name: Wilder Kampf – Katze (Dungeon)
DRUID.note: Unanimous: identical cat build 9/32/10 in Wowhead, Method and Mobalytics.

DRUID.name: Wilder Kampf – Bär (Schlachtzug)
DRUID.note: Wowhead and Method agree exactly on the pure bear raid build (no Shifting Power / Predatory Discipline; Rend and Tear 5, Blood Frenzy 1). Mobalytics bear guide was not reachable (bot protection).

DRUID.name: Wilder Kampf – Bär (Dungeon)
DRUID.note: Hybrid bear/cat for dungeons (can swap to cat). Wowhead tank and DPS guides give the identical build; Method differs by 1 point.

DRUID.name: Wiederherstellung (Schlachtzug)
DRUID.note: Method and Mobalytics agree on 49 of 51 points (11/0/40); last 2 points from the most recent source (Method). Wowhead uses a different 18/0/33 split but the same 33-point Restoration core. Wowhead explicitly uses the raid build for dungeons too.

DRUID.name: Wiederherstellung (Dungeon)
DRUID.note: Method and Mobalytics agree on 49 of 51 points (11/0/40); last 2 points from the most recent source (Method). Wowhead uses a different 18/0/33 split but the same 33-point Restoration core. Wowhead explicitly uses the raid build for dungeons too.

DRUID.name: Wilder Kampf – Bär (Leveln)
DRUID.note: Low confidence: only two sources distinguish bear leveling, and they disagree a lot. Used the Wowhead tank guide's recommended build. Mobalytics bear guide unreachable.

PRIEST.name: Disziplin (Dungeon)
PRIEST.note: Split 33/18/0 shared by CC and wowforeverbuilds; filler points differ. CC (post-launch) chosen. Method has no Discipline guide.

PRIEST.name: Disziplin (Schlachtzug)
PRIEST.note: CC and WT agree (31/20/0 to Power Infusion), 1 filler point differs. Method has no Discipline guide.

PRIEST.name: Heilig (Dungeon)
PRIEST.note: Both sources use a 21/30/0 Penance + Soul Warding hybrid for dungeons; ~5 points differ. CC (newer, 11-17) chosen.

PRIEST.name: Heilig (Schlachtzug)
PRIEST.note: Method and CC agree point for point (16/35/0 to Prayer of Mending). Older pre-launch builds used 18/33 with Soul Warding instead of Holy Reach.

PRIEST.name: Schatten (Dungeon)
PRIEST.note: Raid build with the 3 Holy points and 2 Mental Strength moved into Spirit Tap 5/5. Only CC gives an explicit dungeon build; WT text recommends Spirit Tap for dungeons; Method has a single general build.

PRIEST.name: Schatten (Schlachtzug)
PRIEST.note: Shadow core (Shadow Focus 5, Imp. Mind Blast 4/5, Imp. Mind Flay, Dark Inspiration, Shadow Weaving, Devouring Contagion, Darkness, Shadowform; Twin Disciplines, Silent Resolve, Meditation) is identical in all post-launch sources. Twilight Focus 3/3 (works in Shadowform since 11-11 hotfix) taken by CC + WT; Method spends those points on Mental Strength/Inner Focus/Early Demise and lists Twilight Focus as an option.

SHAMAN.name: Elementar (Dungeon)
SHAMAN.note: No two-source consensus for a dungeon-specific build. Both multi-target variants add Trial by Fire 2/2 to the shared Elemental core; CC is the only explicit dungeon build. Fallback: use the raid build.

SHAMAN.name: Elementar (Schlachtzug)
SHAMAN.note: Method and CC agree on 31/9/11 (Water Shield, Ancestral Knowledge 4/5); only the row-4 filler point differs (Earthbound vs Trial by Fire). Method (newest) used.

SHAMAN.name: Verstärkung (Dungeon)
SHAMAN.note: Same as raid. Method alt "Extra Hit & Mana Regen" 11/32/8 and CC dungeon 17/26/8 both dip Tidal Focus/Mindfulness when hit or mana is short.

SHAMAN.name: Verstärkung (Schlachtzug)
SHAMAN.note: Elemental 17 points identical in all sources. Main disagreement: Maelstrom Weapon 5/5 (Method, WT) vs 1/5 (CC argues extra points add little) with points into Tidal Focus for hit.

SHAMAN.name: Wiederherstellung (Dungeon)
SHAMAN.note: Method and CC deep-resto builds identical. CC says Totemic Focus is worth 2-3x more in dungeons; CC also lists a mobility dungeon build 0/17/34 (Improved Ghost Wolf, Guardian Totems).

SHAMAN.name: Wiederherstellung (Schlachtzug)
SHAMAN.note: Method and CC deep-resto builds identical. CC primary raid build is 0/10/41 (Thundering Strikes 5 instead of Totemic Focus 5).

MAGE.name: Arkan (Dungeon)
MAGE.note: Arcane Fire is the single standard build for raids and dungeons (Method = CC). Alternative: Pure Arcane (Method 38/10/3, CC 35/13/3) for Fire-immune bosses.

MAGE.name: Arkan (Schlachtzug)
MAGE.note: Arcane Fire is the single standard build for raids and dungeons (Method = CC). Alternative: Pure Arcane (Method 38/10/3, CC 35/13/3) for Fire-immune bosses.

MAGE.name: Feuer (Dungeon)
MAGE.note: All three sources give the identical Frostfire build; CC recommends it for packs. Alternative for dungeons per CC: raid build with Blast Wave instead of 3rd Master of Elements point.

MAGE.name: Feuer (Schlachtzug)
MAGE.note: Method and CC identical. CC dungeon variant only moves 1 Master of Elements point into Blast Wave.

MAGE.name: Frost (Dungeon)
MAGE.note: Method and CC identical (Improved Blizzard 3/3, Missile Barrage, Incineration).

MAGE.name: Frost (Schlachtzug)
MAGE.note: Method and CC identical. Both list a low-threat ST alternative (Method 14/5/32, CC 10/5/36) once mana is no issue.

ROGUE.name: Meucheln (Dungeon)
ROGUE.note: Icy Veins and ConquestCapped (Expose Armor build) are identical. Method goes 35/11/5 (more Improved Poisons, Vigor, 5 Opportunity; no Weapon Expertise/Composure/Endurance). Warcraft Tavern's level-60 Assassination build is pre-rework (mentions removed talent Murder, ranks exceed current maxima) and was ignored.

ROGUE.name: Meucheln (Schlachtzug)
ROGUE.note: WEAK CONSENSUS: no two sources agree on a dedicated raid build. Recorded the only allocation two sources share (Icy Veins general PvE = ConquestCapped dungeon). ConquestCapped's raid build 31/19/1 drops Improved Expose Armor (Warrior Sunder covers it), Weapon Expertise, Lightning Reflexes for Aggression 3, Efficient Strikes 2, Vigor 1, Improved Poisons 2, Opportunity 1. Method: 35/11/5. All share the 31-point Mutilate core (Malice, Ruthlessness, Imp. SnD, Lethality, Cold Blood, Relentless Strikes, Venom, Seal Fate, Mutilate) plus Coup de Grace/Precision/Puncturing Wounds.

ROGUE.name: Kampf (Dungeon)
ROGUE.note: ConquestCapped dungeon build and Method's Sinister Strike build are identical: Deflection 3/3 + Riposte instead of Improved Sprint, Blood Splatter instead of Cold Blood/1 Ruthlessness. WT/Icy Veins only give one PvE build (the raid one, 6-7 points off: Improved Sprint + Cold Blood instead of Deflection 3/Riposte).

ROGUE.name: Kampf (Schlachtzug)
ROGUE.note: Sword/axe/mace Sinister Strike build. Combat tree identical in Warcraft Tavern and ConquestCapped (Deflection 1 + Improved Sprint 2 as row filler; Icy Veins uses Lightning Reflexes 1 instead of Deflection 1). Assassination 16: Improved Expose Armor 2 taken by WT + Icy Veins; ConquestCapped puts those 2 points into Vigor instead (Expose Armor does not stack with a Warrior's Sunder Armor). Dagger variant (13/33/5 Backstab + Puncturing Wounds + Opportunity) exists in all sources but not recorded here.

ROGUE.name: Täuschung (Dungeon)
ROGUE.note: ConquestCapped dungeon build = raid build with Setup 3 instead of Heightened Senses 2 + Camouflage 1; Icy Veins also takes Setup 3 + Improved Ambush 3 (but Camouflage 2 instead of Elusiveness 2, and Lethality instead of Precision). Partial agreement only.

ROGUE.name: Täuschung (Schlachtzug)
ROGUE.note: All three share the same 23-point Subtlety core (Opportunity, Dirty Deeds, Initiative, Premeditation, Serrated Blades, Ghostly Strike, Preparation, Hemorrhage, Boot Knife, Death Mark) plus Malice/Ruthlessness/Blood Splatter/Coup de Grace/Efficient Strikes. They disagree on the last ~8 points: CC (most recent) Improved Ambush 3 + Elusiveness 2 + Heightened Senses 2 + Camouflage 1 and Precision 3 for hit; Icy Veins Setup 3 + Camouflage 2, WT Master of Deception 3 + Camouflage 3, both take Lethality 2 instead of Precision (CC suggests that swap once hit-capped). Took CC as most recent; only partial agreement. Method's Subtlety builds decode to 21 Subtlety points without Death Mark (broken/outdated) and were ignored.

HUNTER.name: Tierherrschaft (Dungeon)
HUNTER.note: Icy Veins, Method and WT give one PvE build for all content, recorded here as dungeon too. Only ConquestCapped has a separate dungeon build (35/16/0: Efficiency 5, Improved Mend Pet 2, Frenzy 5, no Rapid Killing/Mortal Shots).

HUNTER.name: Tierherrschaft (Schlachtzug)
HUNTER.note: BM tree (31) identical in Icy Veins and Method (Improved Revive Pet 2, Endurance Training 1, Frenzy 5); WT/CC put those points into Endurance Training instead. Marksmanship 20 is a per-talent majority: Lethal Attacks 5, Careful Aim 5 (all), Rapid Killing 2 (IV/CC/Method), Trueshot Aura 1 + Mortal Shots 4 (WT/CC/Method), last 3 in Improved Stings (IV/WT; Method Hawk Eye, CC Efficiency). Every source is within 3 points.

HUNTER.name: Treffsicherheit (Dungeon)
HUNTER.note: Lone Wolf (no pet) build. Icy Veins and ConquestCapped identical (CC labels it raid AND dungeon). WT swaps Hawk Eye 3 + 1 Efficiency + 1 Barrage for Improved Arcane Shot 5. Method puts 13 points into Survival (Entrapment/Surefooted) instead of Efficiency/Improved Stings. Pet variant (16/31/4) also exists in IV/CC/Method.

HUNTER.name: Treffsicherheit (Schlachtzug)
HUNTER.note: Lone Wolf (no pet) build. Icy Veins and ConquestCapped identical (CC labels it raid AND dungeon). WT swaps Hawk Eye 3 + 1 Efficiency + 1 Barrage for Improved Arcane Shot 5. Method puts 13 points into Survival (Entrapment/Surefooted) instead of Efficiency/Improved Stings. Pet variant (16/31/4) also exists in IV/CC/Method.

HUNTER.name: Überleben (Dungeon)
HUNTER.note: WEAK CONSENSUS: all three agree on a melee build with pet (16-18 BM points incl. Deadly Aspects 5, Focused Fire 2, Unleashed Fury 5, Summon Hawk) and the Survival core (Improved Tracking, Savage Strikes, Surefooted, Predator's Edge, Strider Kick, Expose Prey), but no two allocations match: BM part of CC = Method exactly; CC goes 31 deep (Lacerating Strikes, Survivalist's Discipline, Resourcefulness), Icy Veins/Method stop at 25 Survival and put the rest in Marksmanship (Lethal Attacks/Careful Aim). Took CC (most recent, explicitly dungeon).

HUNTER.name: Überleben (Schlachtzug)
HUNTER.note: Ranged/melee weaving with Lone Wolf, no pet. ConquestCapped and WT identical except Survivalist 3 (CC, also Icy Veins) vs Deflection 3 (WT). Icy Veins weaving build stops at 30 Survival (no Lacerating Strikes, Mortal Shots 5). Method's weaving build keeps a pet (15/10/26) and differs a lot.

WARLOCK.name: Gebrechen (Dungeon)
WARLOCK.note: Shadow Mastery + Ruin (Shadow Bolt filler, no channel on the move). ConquestCapped dungeon = WT SM Ruin with the Cataclysm->Shadowburn swap WT itself suggests for dungeons; Method is 2 points off (Improved Bane of Agony 2, Cataclysm 2). Icy Veins only lists the Wrack build.

WARLOCK.name: Gebrechen (Schlachtzug)
WARLOCK.note: Full consensus: all four sources give the identical Wrack build (Demonic Sacrifice, Improved Shadow Bolt).

WARLOCK.name: Dämonologie (Dungeon)
WARLOCK.note: Fire/Imp build (sacrifice Succubus, Hellfire/Rain of Fire get the Fire bonus). CC and WT identical and both name it the dungeon pick; Method's Fire Brand is 2 points off (Fel Domination instead of 2nd Demonic Energies, Suppression 2). Icy Veins only lists the Succubus build.

WARLOCK.name: Dämonologie (Schlachtzug)
WARLOCK.note: Shadow/Succubus Demonic Pact build: CC and WT identical, Icy Veins 1 point off (Improved Corruption 2 instead of Suppression 1 + Imp. Corruption 1). Method's Shadow Brand takes Fel Domination and Aftermath instead of Demonic Energies 2/Improved Shadow Bolt.

WARLOCK.name: Zerstörung (Dungeon)
WARLOCK.note: Raid Sayaad build with 2 points moved from Suppression into Improved Corruption 5/5 (instant Corruption; dungeon bosses need less hit). CC shows it as its own build, WT describes the same swap in text. Icy Veins uses Demonic Sacrifice for both.

WARLOCK.name: Zerstörung (Schlachtzug)
WARLOCK.note: Destruction 33 points identical in all four sources. Disagreement is the rest: CC + WT (identical) keep the Sayaad out with Unholy Power 4 and 14 Affliction points; Icy Veins recommends Demonic Sacrifice 7/11/33 (CC lists that exact build as the pet-less alternative, slightly lower damage); Method (Nov 4) puts 18 into Affliction without Demonology.
